_comment: Configure additional employer sources here. See README.md for the three tiers this maps to. Nothing here is fetched unless fetch-data.js is run with the right connector enabled.

atsConnectors._comment: TIER 1 - fully sanctioned, documented, free, public APIs built by the ATS vendor for exactly this kind of aggregation. Safe to enable freely.

greenhouse._howToFind: If a company's careers page URL looks like https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/<boardToken> or https://boards.greenhouse.io/<boardToken>, that's your boardToken.

lever._howToFind: If a company's careers page URL looks like https://jobs.lever.co/<company>, that's your company slug.

workable._howToFind: If a company's careers page URL looks like https://apply.workable.com/<accountSlug>/, that's your slug.

smartrecruiters._howToFind: If a company's careers page URL looks like https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<companyId>/, that's your companyId.

grayAreaConnectors._comment: TIER 2 - undocumented endpoints that a company's own careers site calls from the browser (Workday, SuccessFactors, etc.). No vendor sanctions third-party reuse of these; whether it's OK depends on the EMPLOYER's own website terms, not the ATS vendor's. Read the employer's terms of use / robots.txt yourself and set confirmedTermsChecked to true before enabling - fetch-data.js refuses to call these otherwise.

workday._note: Verified live and reachable. Check https://careers.dyson.com's terms of use before flipping this on.
Verified live and reachable (returned real apprenticeship postings while building this). Check https://careers.rolls-royce.com's terms of use before flipping this on.
Verified live and reachable (0 postings when checked - their apprenticeship window opens Nov 3). Check https://www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com's terms of use before flipping this on.

directoryLinks._comment: TIER 3 - employers with no feed at all (custom-built career sites). We don't extract their listings automatically; we just list a link so job-seekers can go look themselves. Shown as a separate 'Company careers pages' section, never mixed into the scraped/fed vacancy list.
